text:
ivy: quick poll  our service overview shows req/s and p95(ms) on one chart. thoughts on axis/legend treatment?
ben: dual y-axis is risky, folks confuse scales. prefer single axis if we can.
samir: single axis only works if we normalize or stack. but ops wants raw ms visible.
olga: compromise: compact stacked rows (small height each) or shared percent axis + absolute-on-hover. space is the limiter.
ivy: stacked looks cleaner but dashboard grid is tight. what about tiny unit pills in legend and a data-table button?
ben: unit pills good. also we should include full-unit text for screen readers. e.g., legend item label: "Throughput, requests per second" (visually "Throughput b7 req/s").
samir: about outliers: large latency spikes ruin the y-scale. options: 1) cap at 99th pct and mark points; 2) log scale; 3) show toggle to expand y-range.
olga: log scale confusing. prefer cap + outlier markers + a small dashed cap line with tooltip: "values above X capped for display". include a chart-setting: "Show raw extremes" default off.
ivy: smoothing note: compute smoothing on raw data (rolling median) then render smoothed line over capped raw points so spikes don't disappear the trend.
ben: copy for hidden SR text: "This chart shows throughput (requests per second) and 95th percentile latency (milliseconds). Use hover or the data table for exact values." concise?
olga: trim to: "Throughput (req/s) and p95 latency (ms). Hover or open data table for raw values."
samir: small formatter rules: throughput use SI short (e.g., 1.2k), latency round + 'ms'. attach code snippet in figma notes.
ivy: action items: @olga add stacked + capped variants to the mock, @samir draft ARIA/hidden text, @ben mock legend pills and SR expansions.
design-bot: summary created: "Prefer capped visualization (99th pct) with outlier markers; avoid dual-axis; provide unit pills + SR-readable legend; smoothing calculated on raw then rendered on capped values; expose toggle to show raw extremes."
ivy: thanks team, will iterate and post updated frames later. :sparkles:
